angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,266,174 km at 224.86 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.4473 +/- 0.0106 mas (same row, RUWE 0.84): 224.86 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.82 +/- 0.15 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-14 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,266,174 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 2.65 +/- 0.73 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-14 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6600 +/- 90 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-14 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-14 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-14.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.341, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-14 (pscomppars): spectral type F5 V, from Simpson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011AJ....141..161S/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-14 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.11 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-14 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.64412, from Fukui et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...819...27F/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-14 (pscomppars): age 1.6 Gyr, from Simpson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011AJ....141..161S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-14 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 8.18 km/s, from Winn et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011AJ....141...63W/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
